parsed.answer: The five most influential papers on stem cells, ranked by citation count, span foundational discoveries in pluripotency, mesenchymal stem cells, and embryonic stem cell derivation. Yamanaka's two landmark iPSC papers (2006 mouse, 2007 human) are the most cited, followed by seminal work on mesenchymal stem cell multilineage potential, standardized MSC criteria, and the first derivation of human embryonic stem cell lines.
